items.title: Flat graded algebras and flat finite graded modules are finitely presented over the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves finite presentation for a flat finitely generated graded algebra and for a flat finite graded module, assuming the ring injects into the product of its localisations at finitely many primes. The proof uses the chosen homogeneous generators to present the algebra as a finite algebra over a graded polynomial ring, which reduces both statements to the case of a graded polynomial ring, where the earlier graded module theorem gives finite presentation after localising at each of the finitely many primes; the injectivity assumption then lets the local finite presentation statements be glued into global finite presentation. The reduction steps are each justified.
